result:
The test suite compiled cleanly against `lib/`.

**Summary:** Created `tests/com/google/gson/internal/bind/JsonAdapterAnnotationTypeAdapterFactoryAgentTest.java` with 11 JUnit 4 tests covering:

- `create()` returns `null` for unannotated types (custom class, JDK `String`, and a generic-argument case showing the raw type — not the type argument — is what's checked)
- `create()` delegates correctly when `@JsonAdapter`'s value is a `TypeAdapter`, a `TypeAdapterFactory`, or a `JsonSerializer` (verified via actual JSON output, not just non-null)
- Error/boundary cases: annotation value implementing none of the supported adapter interfaces, and one that can't be instantiated (abstract class) — both expected to throw `RuntimeException` rather than silently returning null
- Direct exercise of the package-private static `getTypeAdapter` method (accessible since the test lives in the same package)
- A read/write round-trip through the returned adapter

All fixtures (adapters, serializers, annotated classes) are self-contained nested static classes — no external test helpers. `./compile.sh` reports `compiled OK`.
